# Original procedural audio

All sounds and chords are original seeded mathematical synthesis; no external samples, recordings, voice or downloaded music. Generated by scripts/fix-one-bug/audio.py. To the extent copyright applies, audio and this generator are dedicated under CC0 1.0 Universal.

Five time-aligned 48kHz stereo premaster stems are included. Use mix.wav for final edit; stems do not reconstruct loudness mastering exactly.
